description: OpenCV helps programs work with pictures. Learn image arrays, colour order, crops, resizing and simple filters using tiny synthetic images instead of personal photos. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain know the bgr channel order
Explain crop by rows and columns
Explain resize to a chosen size

seo.title: OpenCV Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn OpenCV with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
